get_chat.description: Get one chat with its whole transcript: who said what, and when.

messages.text: It ships today. Here is the receipt.

chat.transcript:
Customer Support: Hi! How can we help?
Martins: Where is my order?
Eugene: It ships today. Here is the receipt.

items.description: A file sent in the chat

sender_id.description: The agent's id, for a message from an agent

output.status: draft, published or archived on the main site.

tawk_to_new_chat_trigger.description: Runs when a chat starts on a tawk.to property.

parameters.description: The website or page whose chats to watch.

output.assignee_name: The agent it is assigned to.

output.subject: Its subject.
